abstract: Amniocentesis was performed in a pregnancy of 26 weeks because of hydramnios. The amniotic fluid was examined for fetal karyotype and AFP content. The latter was elevated to 300 mug/ml. Fetal death occurred shortly after amniocentesis and a malformed male fetus with a large sacrococcygeal teratoma was stillborn 3 days later.
abstract_ja: 妊娠26週、羊水過多のため羊水穿刺を施行した。羊水について胎児核型とAFP含量を検査した。AFPは300μg/mlに上昇していた。穿刺後まもなく胎児死亡が起こり、3日後に大きな仙尾部奇形腫を伴う奇形の男児胎児が死産した。
